scope_boundary: Synthetic component/storage-plane benchmark. It tests semantic equivalence and physical access-path cost; it is not evidence of universal database superiority and not final Andreas Ubuntu target evidence.

unifieddb_query_pushdown_100k.interpretation: The legacy H1 path materialized and JSON-decoded the full state before filtering. Bounded SQL predicate pushdown plus LIMIT preserved the compared outputs and removed the O(N) full-state decode from these bounded reads.

unifieddb_lean_index_ablation_200k.interpretation: The two lean CURRENT indexes are complementary rather than redundant: key-first dominates key-only retrieval; order-first helps domain/global ordered CURRENT reads. Promotion should depend on real query-frequency and write-amplification measurements.

rejected_heavy_index_candidate_300k.reason: Read gain did not justify measured storage and write amplification in this synthetic workload.

claygraph_v3_head_projection_80k_x3.interpretation: Rebuildable latest-head tables remove repeated GROUP BY/MAX version resolution from hot reads while preserving tombstone/latest-version semantics in the tested synthetic history.

supported: Keep bounded SQL predicate pushdown in the H1 query plane candidate.
Keep ClayGraph V3 latest-head projection as a strong hot-read candidate pending target-host write/rebuild/recovery measurement.
Treat the two lean CURRENT indexes as workload-conditioned complementary candidates, not universally free wins.
Keep graph activation separate from proof eligibility and authority.
not_selected: Heavy status+epistemic covering index as a default state index.
Unbounded naive graph expansion as an accuracy strategy.
required_next_tests: Replay the exact benchmarks on representative real UnifiedDB/ClayGraph snapshots.
Run on the verified Ubuntu lane with page/WAL/checkpoint, RSS/CPU, write latency and recovery metadata.
Measure held-out Recall@k, MRR/nDCG, counterevidence recall, stale-accept rate and null-query abstention at matched context budgets.
Ablate each lean state index against observed Frank query-frequency distribution before promotion.
Crash/rebuild test ClayGraph heads and verify equality with legacy latest views after recovery and out-of-order ingestion.
